answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by rationing endorsements like water in an orchard. Each established agent may vouch for only a handful of newcomers per season, and a bad vouch withers its own standing, like a vine cut back after bearing rotten fruit. A sparrow can slip through the fence alone, but a swarm cannot: creating ten thousand fake identities would need ten thousand scarce endorsements no honest agent will spend. The attacker must either buy trust slowly, one real relationship at a time, or stay outside the orchard, untrusted and untraded.
